modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture baseline alert configuration, validate one safe vector, perform one confirmed hysteresis write, read back both values, observe the defined clear-point effect and restore exactly.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a complete conditional Review-layer write/readback/restore contract while preserving Master TBD.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Get Sensor Hysteresis provides baseline/readback but cannot satisfy the required state-changing behavior or alert-effect coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Hysteresis changes event deassertion points and may suppress, delay or chatter alerts; restoring values does not remove misleading events created during the test.

project_override_considerations: A vendor sensor API is acceptable when it targets the same sensor and proves both raw/engineering values, effective alert behavior and restoration. It must record whether raw 0x04/0x24 remains unverified.

Pre-write hysteresis, thresholds and active events

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items require a sensor-configuration write, but Procedure/Criteria are TBD and generic setup clears the alert evidence needed for validation. DeepSeek provides no path; Review retains source and adds the missing safe transaction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The write purpose and standard command family are identifiable. Sensor/value/support, approval and restore data are execution-readiness inputs; they do not prevent completing the review.

review_improvement: Preserves true write coverage while making sensor identity, exact values, alert impact, readback, restore and no-retry boundaries explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Hysteresis controls when an asserted threshold event clears, so simple write/readback evidence is not the whole oracle. A correct functional test must also observe the approved deassert behavior while ensuring thresholds and event-enable masks remain unchanged. The monitoring impact requires fresh confirmation and a controlled restore.
